name: edit_file
description: Replace exact text in an existing file. Example: {"path":"src/app.ts","old_string":"const a = 1;","new_string":"const a = 2;"}. old_string must match the file exactly, including indentation, and occur once; include surrounding lines to make it unique, or set replace_all to change every occurrence. An empty new_string deletes the match. When old_string is not found the error shows the most similar lines. The result reports the replacements and the lines added and removed. Successful edits appear in the Files changed panel.

path.description: File path, absolute or relative to the session cwd.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of exactly one; default false.
